text:
emi: Need a quick decision: what connectivity mode do we ship as the GA default for Private? Options: shared SNAT relay, customer-managed egress (static IPs), or dedicated peering. Also need upgrade + rollback semantics.

todd: My vote: shared relay default. Low friction for field and customers onboard faster. We must include per-tenant quotas and clear billing notes.

harper: Relay ok for GA. But implement a self-serve path for customer-egress that includes an ownership proof (signed token curl). Peering should be enterprise-only and sales-gated.

netops-lee: Peering has long lead times (ASN, legal). Gate it behind Dedicated. For relay, we need IP pool monitoring + automated alerts for exhaustion. Also define IP rotation behaviour.

cs-maya: Field requests: "static egress IPs and audit trails." For customer-egress: validate reachability, provide a dry-run endpoint, and surface status in Console. Also include templates CS can send customers pre-cutover.

emi: Proposal: default=relay, opt-in customer-egress (self-serve), peering=Dedicated-only. Migration: agent drains connections, does a 60s warm for caches, then flips. Rollback if error_rate + latency thresholds exceeded for 2 minutes.

todd: API sketch:
POST /v1/tenants/:id/connectivity {"mode":"relay|egress|peering","egress_ips":["203.0.113.8"],"asn":"64522"}
POST /v1/tenants/:id/connectivity/validate -> dry-run ownership checks

harper: Must handle IPv6-only customers. Relay should either support NAT64 or document constraints. Add IPv6 to validation flow.

netops-lee: Packaging checklist: agent flag, firewall outbound ports (443, 53), DNS resolver notes, healthcheck endpoints, CRD example for toggling mode. I'll draft the checklist.

cs-maya: Add a Console feature showing per-tenant mode, last_probe_time, and revert_reason. Also operator toggle to disable auto-fallback for trusted customers (audit-logged).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created doc draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/private-networking-pathways (comments open) :robot_face:

emi: Ok, consensus reached. Action items: Lee -> checklist + alerts; Todd -> relay capacity model; Harper -> egress validation flow + IPv6 notes; Maya -> CS templates and Console mock. I'll update the roadmap with acceptance criteria and schedule a follow-up next week.

(ended)
